title: Citigroup Announces Full Redemption of Series Y Preferred Stock
detail:

Citigroup Announces Full Redemption of Series Y Preferred Stock
Business Wire
Mon, November 9, 2026 at 3:15 PM CST 2 min read
C
Trade C on Coinbase
Trading disclosure

NEW YORK, November 09, 2026--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Citigroup Inc. is redeeming, in whole, all $1.0 billion aggregate liquidation preference of 1,000,000 Depositary Shares each representing a 1/25th interest in its 4.150% Fixed Rate Reset Noncumulative Preferred Stock, Series Y (the "Preferred Stock").

The redemption date is November 15, 2026, for the Preferred Stock and related Depositary Shares (the "Redemption Date"). The cash redemption price for each Depositary Share will equal $1,000 and will be paid on November 16, 2026 (the "Redemption Payment Date"), the business day immediately following the Redemption Date. Holders of record on November 6, 2026, will receive the previously declared regular quarterly dividend of $10.375 per Depositary Share payable on the Redemption Payment Date.

The redemption announced today reflects Citigroup's ongoing efforts to enhance the efficiency of its funding and capital structure. Citigroup's redemptions are based on several factors, including without limitation, the economic value, regulatory changes, potential impact on Citigroup's net interest margin and borrowing costs, the overall remaining tenor of Citigroup's debt portfolio, capital impact, as well as overall market conditions.

Beginning on the Redemption Date, dividends will no longer accrue on the Preferred Stock, and as of the Redemption Payment Date, the Depositary Shares representing the redeemed Preferred Stock will no longer be outstanding.

Computershare Trust Company, N.A. ("Computershare") is the paying agent for the Depositary Shares. The paying agent's address is Computershare Trust Company, Attn: Corporate Actions, 150 Royall Street, Suite 101, Canton, MA 02021. Questions relating to the notice of redemption and related materials should be directed to Computershare via telephone at 1-888-250-3985.

For further information on the Preferred Stock and the related Depositary Shares, please see the prospectus at the following web address: https://www.citigroup.com/rcs/citigpa/storage/public/CitiOct102821PreferredStockSeriesY.pdf.

About Citi

Citi is a preeminent banking partner for institutions with cross-border needs, a global leader in wealth management and a valued personal bank in its home market of the United States. Citi does business in more than 180 countries and jurisdictions, providing corporations, governments, investors, institutions and individuals with a broad range of financial products and services.

Additional information may be found at www.citigroup.com | X: @Citi | LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/citi | YouTube: www.youtube.com/citi | Facebook: www.facebook.com/citi

title: Citigroup (C) Replaces Equities Executive David Haldane With Rob Smolen
detail:
Citigroup (C) Replaces Equities Executive David Haldane With Rob Smolen
Bailey Pemberton
Mon, November 9, 2026 at 12:07 PM CST 3 min read
C
Trade C on Coinbase
Trading disclosure

Citigroup (NYSE:C) has reshuffled leadership in its equities division, replacing global derivatives and EMEA equities head David Haldane.

Rob Smolen, previously global head of exotics and hybrids trading, will take over Haldane's responsibilities in the equities business.

The management change alters oversight of global derivatives and EMEA equities trading, which are key parts of Citigroup's securities unit.

This leadership switch in Citigroup's equities arm comes alongside broader shifts in how the bank organizes its trading activities. Take a look at 6 other big wins we have identified for Citigroup.

Explore other stocks in the broader financials space that share some of the organisational traits investors often look for in 26 top founder-led companies.

NYSE:C 1-Year Stock Price Chart

Citigroup, a US based banking group with a market value of about $197.1b, runs a broad securities and trading operation that sits alongside its consumer, corporate, and government finance arms. As a result, a change in equities leadership can influence how risk and resources are balanced across the wider institution.

Does the team leading Citigroup have what it takes? See our full breakdown of the management team's track record and compensation.

How this Citigroup equities reshuffle feeds into the bigger story

The broad Citigroup Narrative is that the bank is trying to turn services growth, AI driven efficiency and a simpler structure into stronger returns on tangible equity, while keeping conduct and regulatory issues under control.

Does this equities shake up move Citigroup's transformation story forward?

Citigroup's Narrative rests on the idea that leadership can convert a leaner, more focused trading and services set up into better productivity and capital use without letting control risks creep back in.

"The main requirement is that Citigroup continues to convert its services growth, AI driven efficiency efforts and business simplification into sustained double digit returns on tangible common equity..."

See how the full story points towards a $151 fair value for Citigroup.

This reshuffle keeps the spotlight on whether Citigroup's transformation is genuinely embedding simpler reporting lines and tighter control in trading, not just shifting titles. Moving a specialist from exotics and hybrids into broader equities oversight may support the push for AI and automation driven risk management that the Narrative highlights, especially beside peers like JPMorgan and Bank of America.

At the same time, any disruption or misalignment in derivatives and EMEA equities could cut across the goal of steady services like returns from markets businesses and remind investors of the regulatory and conduct risks analysts already flag. The next test is how consistently management explains risk appetite, capital allocation and controls in the trading unit under this new set up.

Wall Street's investment banks are leaning into the wave of giant initial public offerings (IPOs), and Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) is paying to own more of that pipeline. Morgan Stanley stock is at $189.23, up 4% during the afternoon session. Nikada / iStock Unreleased via Getty Images

U.S. stocks are staging a broad rally as investors return to artificial intelligence (AI) and growth shares after last week's post-midterm selloff. Bank stocks are joining in, and Morgan Stanley and the other investment banks are running ahead of the more diversified lenders.

Morgan Stanley Buys Vinyl Equity to Lock In IPO Wealth

Morgan Stanley agreed on November 9 to acquire Vinyl Equity. The terms weren't disclosed, and the deal is expected to close in Q1 2027. Vinyl Equity brings tokenization capabilities and is expected to support Morgan Stanley at Work, the bank's workplace wealth unit that manages employee stock plans.

Scott Whatley, head of Morgan Stanley at Work, noted the bank already serves more than 1,000 private companies, a roster that represents a large share of existing unicorns. That reach builds on Morgan Stanley's earlier acquisition of EquityZen, which gives the firm's clients access to private-market shares.

title: Citigroup sends major warning after $3 trillion stock wipeout
detail:
Citigroup sends major warning after $3 trillion stock wipeout
Faizan Farooque
Mon, November 9, 2026 at 12:55 PM CST 1 min read
^IXIC
C
Trade C on Coinbase
Trading disclosure

This article first appeared on GuruFocus.

Citigroup Inc. (C, Financials) lowered U.S. stocks to Neutral from Overweight , citing increasing worries over artificial intelligence spending, regulatory risks and investor positioning.Beata Manthey and other strategists said they want to see more steady mood in AI stocks after a big selloff in the market.Positioning in important indices such as the Nasdaq could continue to erode as investors cut exposure to technology stocks, the bank cautioned.The recent sell-off has eliminated around $3 trillion in market value from firms in the S&P 500.The fall came after last week's U.S. midterm elections, where the Democrats gained seats and raised fears about possible curbs on data-center building.Investors are also wondering if the heavy investment in AI infrastructure will pay off.Citigroup downgraded the global and European technology sectors to Neutral from Overweight.The bank also upgraded European stocks ex-UK on less exposure to tech volatility and higher upside from declining oil prices.It also upgraded global healthcare and European food and beverage shares to Overweight.The developments show Citigroup is favoring more diversification while the investment in AI remains questionable.The next driver is whether tech equities will recover and whether investors can regain confidence in the pace and profitability of AI infrastructure expenditure.
